data_source_short_label_zh: 新西兰国防军 UFO 档案

events.title: White light seen southeast of Wanganui, changing to green
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A woman who contacted Wanganui Police Station. She would not give her name or address. She said she had also seen the light on the previous two nights.

**Sighting:** At about 22:45 on 4 Jan 2001, she reported a light in the southeast direction from Wanganui, apparently travelling toward Fordell.

**Object:** Initially a white light, later changing to green.

**Tactics:** No maneuvers or interactions were described beyond its movement and color change.

**Note:** The report is a brief police message summary, not a full interview.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名向旺加努伊警察局报案的女子。她拒绝提供姓名和地址，并表示她在前两晚也看到了同样的光。

**目击经过：** 2001年1月4日约22:45，她报告称在旺加努伊东南方向看到一个光点，似乎正朝福德尔（Fordell）方向移动。

**物体：** 起初是白光，后来变成绿色。

**轨迹/行为：** 除了移动和颜色变化外，没有描述其他机动动作或互动。

**备注：** 这是一份简短的警方消息摘要，而不是完整访谈记录。

events.title: Low steady light seen southeast of Wellington Airport
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Several members of the same family.

**Sighting:** A low-level steady light was seen approximately 4 nautical miles southeast of NZWB (Wellington Airport). It was watched for about one hour.

**Object:** The light was steady, but at intervals it burst into a fireworks-like display before returning to a steady light. It eventually disappeared after roughly an hour.

**Tactics:** No maneuvers were reported beyond the repeated bursting/returning cycle; it remained low level throughout the observation.

**Note:** Conditions were described as a clear night with high cirrus, visibility about 40 km, temperature 8°C, dew point 7°C.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 同一家中的几个人。

**目击：** 在 NZWB（惠灵顿机场）东南约 4 海里处，看见一个低空的稳定光点，持续观察约 1 小时。

**物体：** 该光点最初是稳定的，但会间歇性地像烟花一样爆裂成光束/火花状，然后又恢复为稳定光点；最终在约 1 小时后消失。

**行为：** 未报告其他机动动作，只描述了反复“爆裂—恢复稳定”的循环；整个观察期间一直处于低空。

**备注：** 当时为晴夜，有高层卷云，能见度约 40 公里，气温 8°C，露点 7°C。

events.title: Two triangular UFOs seen over Roseneath toward Evans Bay
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** An unnamed person reported the event to RNZAF HQ; they also said a friend saw it, but no further identity details were provided.

**Sighting:** Two UFOs were watched from midnight to 1am over Roseneath, Wellington, moving out into the Evans Bay area.

**Object:** The first was smaller, with an orange light at the back and a white beam at the front; the second was larger with a white light. Both were described as triangular in shape.

**Tactics:** The smaller object flew underneath the larger one, then a beam of light came from the larger UFO down toward the water in Evans Bay.

**Note:** The page appears to be a fax summary of the sighting, with wind/visibility notes and internal RNZAF routing marks.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名未具名的目击者向新西兰皇家空军总部报告了此事，并称其朋友也看到了，但未提供更多身份信息。

**目击：** 据称在午夜至凌晨1点之间，于惠灵顿 Roseneath 上空目击到两架不明飞行物，并朝 Evans Bay 区域移动。

**物体：** 第一架较小，尾部有橙色灯，前方有白色光束；第二架较大，带白色灯。两者都被描述为三角形。

**动作：** 较小的物体飞到较大物体下方，随后较大物体向下发出一道光束，照向 Evans Bay 的水面。

**注：** 该页看起来是这起目击事件的传真摘要，并包含风速/能见度备注以及内部 RNZAF 流转标记。

events.title: Palmerston North airfield light seen moving west back and forth
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Palmerston North tower personnel (not on watch) reported the event.

**Sighting:** Around 1000 UTC on 25 Feb 2000, a light was seen over Palmerston North.

**Object:** It was described as a “dull light” moving west and then back and forth at varying speeds, “not like an aircraft” and “not like a searchlight.”

**Tactics:** No evasive action or tracking details were recorded; only the motion and visual impression were noted.

**Note:** The report includes an estimate of wind 200/05, visibility 30 km and cloud broken at 2000 ft, but no identification of the light was made.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 事件由帕默斯顿北塔台人员（当班以外）报告。

**目击：** 2000年2月25日约UTC 1000时，在帕默斯顿北上空看到一处光点。

**物体：** 其被描述为“微弱的光”，向西移动，随后以不同速度来回移动，“不像飞机”，也“不像探照灯”。

**行动：** 记录中未提到规避或跟踪动作，仅记下其运动方式和视觉印象。

**备注：** 报告还写有估计风向风速200/05、能见度30公里、云底2000英尺，但未能确认该光点的身份。

events.title: Star-like light with surrounding web formation east of Howick
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Unnamed observer(s) in Howick, Auckland, with the sighting also checked against AA tower controller and two aircraft west of Auckland.

**Sighting:** At 2255 local on 15 Nov 1999, a light was seen east of Howick toward Whitford/Coromandel.

**Object:** Described as a central star-like light with a web formation surrounding it; it appeared motionless and seemed closer than the Coromandel Peninsula when viewed with binoculars.

**Tactics:** No maneuvering was reported; the note says it could not be verified by tower control or nearby aircraft.

**Note:** Partial cloud was present.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 奥克兰 Howick 的未具名观察者；记录还提到曾向 AA 塔台管制员和奥克兰西侧两架飞机核实。

**目击经过：** 1999年11月15日当地时间22:55，在 Howick 以东、朝 Whitford/Coromandel 方向看见一束光。

**物体：** 被描述为一个中心星状光点，周围有网状结构；用双筒望远镜看时，它静止不动，并且看起来比科罗曼德尔半岛更近。

**动态：** 未报告机动动作；备注称塔台和附近飞机均无法证实。

**备注：** 当时有部分云层。

events.title: Light seen north of Whakatane moving NW then sharply SE
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Unidentified witness/observer, relayed in an RNZAF safety investigation fax.

**Sighting:** On 15 Nov 1993, at about 2145 and again at 2220 local, a light was seen north of Whakatane.

**Object:** Described as similar to a star/satellite, visible in clear skies with stars also visible. It moved initially northwest, then sharply changed direction to the southeast.

**Tactics:** No noise was associated with the movement, and it was only visible for a few minutes each time.

**Note:** The report contains two short observations of the same type of light and does not identify the witness by name.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 未具名目击者/观察者，经由 RNZAF 安全调查传真转报。

**目击：** 1993年11月15日约21:45和22:20（当地时间），在 Whakatane 以北看到一个发光体。

**物体：** 被描述为类似恒星/卫星，在天空晴朗、可见星星的情况下出现。它最初向西北移动，随后突然转向东南。

**行为特征：** 运动过程中没有任何声音，每次只可见几分钟。

**备注：** 这份报告包含两次相似的短暂观察，且未说明目击者姓名。

events.title: Bright yellow light seen south of Hamilton
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A person in the Hamilton area reported the event by phone, and a second witness in Mt Maunganui later reported a similar object.

**Sighting:** On 11 Aug 1999 at about 0730 UTC, a bright yellow light was observed well south of Hamilton city.

**Object:** The light was still at first, then moved upward about 1 inch on the horizon before accelerating rapidly away from the witness and into space; it was visible for about 10 seconds.

**Tactics:** No maneuvering lights or cover were noted; the object simply paused, rose, and departed quickly.

**Note:** The report says a second UFO of the same description was seen 30 seconds to 1 minute after the initial sighting.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 汉密尔顿地区的一名目击者通过电话报告了事件，随后芒格努伊山（Mt Maunganui）另一名目击者也报告了一个相似物体。

**目击：** 1999年8月11日约07:30 UTC，在汉密尔顿市以南很远处看到一个明亮的黄色光点。

**物体：** 该光点起初静止，随后在地平线上向上移动约1英寸，之后迅速朝远离目击者的方向飞走并进入天空；整个可见时间约10秒。

**动作：** 未提到闪光灯或掩蔽特征；物体只是停顿、上升并快速离开。

**备注：** 报告称，在最初目击后30秒到1分钟内，又看到了一个描述相同的第二个不明飞行物。

events.title: Bright fireball over Tauranga, moving east-to-west
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** An unidentified report reached RNZAF HQ/D Ops.

**Sighting:** At about 0415 on 7 July, a very fast object was seen over Tauranga descending from east to west at roughly a 25-degree angle.

**Object:** Described as a very bright “fireball” with trailing smoke; classified in the message as a meteorite.

**Tactics:** No evasive or structured maneuvering was reported, only rapid descent across the sky.

**Note:** The page is a terse operational message/fax summary, but it records a concrete local event rather than editorial material.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一份不具名报告被转送至 RNZAF 总部 / D Ops。

**目击经过：** 7 月 7 日约 0415，在陶朗加上空有人看到一个非常快速的物体，以约 25 度角从东向西下降。

**物体：** 被描述为非常明亮的“火球”，并拖着烟迹；电文中将其标为陨石。

**机动：** 未报告任何规避或结构化机动，只是快速穿越天空并下坠。

**备注：** 该页是简短的作战电报/传真摘要，但记录的是一个具体的本地事件，而非编辑内容。

events.title: Two erratically moving objects reported near Woodbourne, Blenheim
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A civilian phoned Air Traffic Control at RNZAF Woodbourne.

**Sighting:** The report records two objects seen in the sky in the Blenheim/Woodbourne area.

**Object:** The objects were described as moving rapidly and erratically; no further shape or colour detail is given on this page.

**Tactics:** The sighting was logged as being about 5 NM northwest of NZWB.

**Note:** This page appears to be a brief faxed incident summary, not a full narrative, but it does refer to a concrete sighting event.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名平民致电 RNZAF Woodbourne 的空中交通管制。

**目击经过：** 记录称在布伦海姆/Woodbourne 地区的天空中看见了两个物体。

**物体：** 这些物体被描述为快速且不规则地移动；本页未提供更多外形或颜色细节。

**动向：** 记录显示该目击点约在 NZWB 西北 5 海里处。

**备注：** 这一页看起来是简短的传真事件摘要，而非完整叙述，但确实对应一个具体的目击事件。

events.title: Amberley vapour-trail UFO report
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A man and a companion reported the event by phone after seeing it near Amberley.

**Sighting:** Around 12:45 pm on Sunday they observed unusual vapour trails heading south to north/NW at high altitude just north of Amberley.

**Object:** The trails looked markedly different from normal aircraft contrails, appearing very high, very short, expanding rapidly, and one trail was followed by another parallel trail and then a third; a small white object seemed to lead one trail and appeared to be descending.

**Tactics:** The caller said he had prior familiarity with aircraft and wanted a call back as he was considering forming a UFO society.

**Note:** Defence later found no matching civilian caller and noted two Andovers were transiting south-north in the area at the time, with the description matching normal aircraft vapour trails.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名男子和一位同伴在阿默里附近报告了该事件。

**目击经过：** 周日中午约12:45，他们在阿默里以北看到异常的凝结尾迹，方向为由南向北/西北，且高度很高。

**物体：** 这些尾迹与普通飞机尾迹明显不同，显得很高、很短，并迅速向外扩散；其中一条之后又出现一条平行尾迹，随后又有第三条；一枚小白色物体似乎领着其中一条尾迹，并看起来在下降。

**策略：** 来电者表示自己熟悉飞机，并希望回电，因为他正考虑在当地成立一个UFO协会。

**备注：** 国防部门随后未能找到对应的民用来电者，并指出当时该区域有两架Andover运输机南北向通过，描述与正常飞机尾迹相符。

events.title: Porirua Basin red-pink flashing object over valley
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A telephone caller from the Porirua Basin, likely a middle-aged woman, reported the event and said her sighting should be taken seriously.

**Sighting:** Around 2200 on 6 Apr 1998, a bright object appeared high over the western hills of the Porirua valley, moved rapidly across the valley in about 10 seconds, then hovered over the eastern hills for about 25 minutes before occasionally drifting up and down.

**Object:** Described as a large round/oval reddish-pink object with lights that flashed and moved, lowering its apparent circumference.

**Tactics:** It seemed to hover unusually high, transit quickly, then remain stationary; weather was calm and clear except for light raindrops on the witness’s arm.

**Note:** The report notes similar earlier sightings in the same valley and suggests possible wildfire/light-windballoon misidentification, though the witness felt it was not an aircraft.
events.report_summary_zh:
**见证人：** 来自波里鲁阿盆地的一名电话报案者，可能是一位中年女性；她表示此事应被认真对待。

**目击：** 1998年4月6日约22:00，一个明亮物体出现在波里鲁阿谷西侧山丘上方，约10秒内快速穿过山谷，随后在东侧山丘上方悬停约25分钟，并偶尔上下漂移。

**物体：** 被描述为一个大而圆/椭圆的红粉色物体，灯光会闪烁并移动，外观周长似乎在变化。

**行动方式：** 它似乎在异常高空悬停，快速横穿后长时间停留；当时天气平静晴朗，但目击者手臂上有细小雨滴。

**备注：** 报告提到该山谷此前也有类似目击，并怀疑可能是野火或风灯/气球误认，但目击者认为那不是飞机。

events.title: Silver disc-shaped object seen north of Dannevirke
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** Five radio-control modellers flying model aircraft near SH2, north of Dannevirke.

**Sighting:** At about 2148Z on 7 Feb 1998 they reported a UFO while outdoors in clear skies with a light westerly breeze.

**Object:** A silver, disc-shaped object was seen very high overhead, moving south-west at very high speed; no known aircraft were in the vicinity.

**Tactics:** None reported.

**Note:** The message is a brief RNZAF safety-investigation telex noting the sighting location as 17 km north of Dannevirke on SH2.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 5名正在公路模型飞机的无线电遥控玩家，在丹尼弗克北侧、SH2公路附近。

**目击：** 1998年2月7日约2148Z，他们在晴朗天空、微弱西风条件下报告看到不明飞行物。

**物体：** 一个银色、圆盘状物体在头顶极高空高速向西南方向移动；附近没有已知飞机。

**战术：** 未报告。

**注：** 这是一份RNZAF安全调查电报，地点记为丹尼弗克以北17公里的SH2公路附近。

events.title: NZ Post flight crew reports two strobe-like lights south of Kaikoura
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** The pilot and co-pilot of NZ Post flight AP 75 (Palmerston North to Christchurch) reported the event.

**Sighting:** At about 12:30 am, roughly 20 miles south of Kaikoura, they saw two separate strobes/high-intensity lights while cruising level at 14,000 ft.

**Object:** The lights moved with a northerly direction and very high apparent speed, had unusually long gaps between flashes, and no navigation lights were visible. One passed directly overhead; the second appeared to travel on a parallel track to the east, briefly trailing the first.

**Tactics:** The crew queried Christchurch radar, which reported no primary/secondary targets or planned traffic in the area, though a northbound company aircraft was later noted passing beneath them.

**Note:** The writer concluded the objects were unlike commercial jets and suggested they may have been unidentified foreign military aircraft.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** NZ Post 航班 AP 75（从 Palmerston North 飞往 Christchurch）的飞行员和副驾驶报告了这次事件。

**目击：** 大约在凌晨 12:30，地点在 Kaikoura 以南约 20 英里、巡航高度 14,000 英尺时，他们看见两道分离的强闪烁灯光。

**物体：** 这些灯光向北移动，表观速度很高，闪光间隔异常长，没有可见的航行灯。其中一道直接从机顶掠过；另一道似乎在东侧平行航迹飞行，并短暂尾随第一道灯光。

**战术：** 机组询问 Christchurch 雷达，回复称该区域没有主/次雷达目标，也没有计划中的交通；后来提到一架北向公司飞机从他们下方通过。

**备注：** 报告者认为这些目标不像民航喷气机，并推测可能是未申报的外国军机。

events.title: White star-like object seen over Eastbourne and Wellington Harbour
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A man who phoned the RNZAF Media Liaison Officer, describing a sighting made with three companions from the Marsden Memorial area.

**Sighting:** At about 0430 on 12 Jan 1995 they watched the stars for roughly 10 minutes and saw an object moving in a zig-zag pattern.

**Object:** It appeared as a star-like white object, initially moving west from above Eastbourne, circling over the harbour, then returning east into the sky over Eastbourne. It was estimated to be very high, around 60,000 ft.

**Tactics:** The observer later said he had seen a similar object about three years earlier near Seatoun.

**Note:** RNZAF and civil traffic checks reportedly found no aircraft or obvious activity to explain it; weather was fine/clear.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一名男子致电新西兰皇家空军媒体联络官，称他与另外三名同伴在 Marsden Memorial 一带观看到该现象。

**目击：** 1995年1月12日约0430，他们看星空约10分钟时，看到一个物体以之字形移动。

**物体：** 它看起来像一颗白色星点，最初从 Eastbourne 上方向西移动，在港湾上空盘旋后，又向东返回到 Eastbourne 上方天空。其高度估计非常高，约60,000英尺。

**策略：** 该目击者后来表示，大约三年前他在 Seatoun 附近还见过类似物体。

**备注：** RNZAF 和民航方面的查询据称未发现当时有可解释的飞机或活动；天气晴朗、能见度良好。

events.title: Porirua triangle with three bright lights
events.record_description: New Zealand Defence Force declassified UFO file (released under Official Information Act).
events.report_summary:
**Witness:** A Porirua resident and a friend were walking outside early in the morning when they looked at the sky.

**Sighting:** At about 0531 on 27 Oct 1994, they saw an unidentified object over Porirua moving slowly westward.

**Object:** Described as a triangular-shaped object with three bright lights; the report says this was their first such sighting.

**Tactics:** Wellington Air Traffic Control also logged two reports around 0510/0520, describing a small, slow, bright light moving west to east.

**Note:** The defence duty officer took the call at about 0900 and passed the report to the UFO file; weather was fine/clear and no RNZAF traffic was identified.
events.report_summary_zh:
**目击者：** 一位波里鲁阿（Porirua）居民和他的朋友在清晨外出时抬头看天空。

**目击经过：** 1994年10月27日约0531，他们在波里鲁阿上空看到一个身份不明的物体，缓慢向西移动。

**物体：** 据称为三角形物体，带有三个明亮的灯光；报告称这是他们首次见到此类现象。

**动作/特征：** 惠灵顿空管也记录了约0510/0520的两次报告，描述为一个小而缓慢、发亮的光点，由西向东移动。

**备注：** 国防值班官员约0900接到电话并将其归档到UFO档案；当时天气晴朗，未发现RNZAF航班活动。
